summary: Frontend-only testing of new Help & FAQ / PDF Guide feature and admin.tsx section reorder. All requirements verified via live browser automation on mobile viewport (375x667). Order of admin sections confirmed correct: Help&FAQ (top) -> Season period -> Banner -> Appearance -> Language -> Danger (careplan reset) -> Database (bottom, after danger section). /help screen renders correctly with header (close X, title, download icon), intro text, 8 category cards with FAQ accordion (multi-open supported, chevron toggles, collapse works). PDF download buttons (header icon, bottom button, admin button) all correctly show the web-unsupported toast on web preview without any crash/red-screen (expected behavior since expo-print/expo-sharing native APIs aren't available in web preview - consistent with prior iteration findings for weight PDF export). Close button navigates back to /admin correctly. Language switch Danish<->English verified working for both Admin Help section labels and /help screen content; app was left restored to Danish (primary language) at the end of testing. Regression smoke test of Overview, Dragons, Schedules, Tasks tabs and Database export/import buttons showed no issues.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.tsx and help.tsx both correctly guard PDF generation with Platform.OS==='web' check before calling expo-print/expo-sharing, avoiding crashes in web preview (consistent with fix pattern from earlier iterations for weight PDF export).

help.tsx CONTENT object (Danish/English FAQ text) and guidePdf.ts GUIDE object contain large duplicated content blocks (~650 and ~300 lines respectively) - acceptable for this data-driven feature, no code smell beyond expected static content size, but help.tsx file is close to 670 lines - consider extracting CONTENT dictionary to a separate data file (e.g. i18n/helpContent.ts) if further sections are added later, to keep the component file smaller.

No testID found for missing scenarios; all testIDs used in this feature (admin-help-faq-button, admin-help-pdf-button, help-close-button, help-download-pdf-button, help-category-*, help-faq-*, help-bottom-pdf-button) are present and correctly wired.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Help & FAQ feature, PDF guide download, and admin.tsx section reorder are all fully verified and working correctly on web preview. Real native Sharing.shareAsync() share-sheet behavior remains untestable in web preview by design (Sharing.isAvailableAsync() returns false on web) - this is expected and not a blocker, same limitation documented for the pre-existing Weight PDF export and DB export/import features. If actual PDF file generation/sharing needs verification, it would require testing on a real device or Expo Go, which is outside the scope of this web-preview browser automation.
